subject: small cube-shaped block of rough stone wall, exactly as wide as it is tall and as deep, half a metre each way, on its own: only three or four rough fieldstones in it, each almost as big as a face of the cube, seen at a three-quarter view showing its front, its side and its top, all three faces the same square size; its faces cut flat and square so blocks stack and butt edge to edge; the same rough grey fieldstone, ochre staining, lichen and pale lime mortar as the reference wall, its stones irregular and rough-faced, never neat bricks, the mortar recessed a little between them
